title: DROPS Design Portuguese knitting glossary
passage_and_limitations: Craft concepts: malha/ponto, meia/ liga, carreira/volta, tension/swatch, next/alternate, wraps and short rows. Valid alternatives were preserved. Not used as authority for every numerical conversion.

title: Rosários 4 / LimaKnits, Lividus XS tutorial, p.4 abbreviations
passage_and_limitations: Independent native craft pattern: meia/ liga, carreiras/voltas, knitwise slipping, PPM, A1E/A1D and lifted increases. These establish operation distinctions, not a mandatory global house vocabulary.

title: DMC, Como ler diagramas de tricô
passage_and_limitations: Working-yarn front/back, knit versus purl, twisted stitches and chart technique vocabulary. Only relevant technique passages used; no wholesale adoption of the site wording.

title: Rosários 4, Marialva product specification
passage_and_limitations: Package mass/length, needle size and thickness category are distinct quantities. Product-specific estimates are not generalized to other yarns.

title: Craft Yarn Council, Knitting Abbreviations
passage_and_limitations: Token identity and operation direction: English tokens remain in the reference and are disclosed as such. Portuguese wording checked separately with native craft sources.

title: Craft Yarn Council, Knit Chart Symbols
passage_and_limitations: Right-side symbol convention, slipped stitch yarn position and cable directions; matched current shared data/rendering evidence. Not a claim of universal chart notation.

title: Craft Yarn Council, How to Measure Wraps Per Inch
passage_and_limitations: Count adjacent, nonoverlapping wraps over one inch without excessive tension. WPI is an estimate, not a package mass or exact universal yarn category.

title: GINETEX, Care symbols
passage_and_limitations: Professional dry cleaning P permits perchloroethylene/hydrocarbons; F hydrocarbon solvents. Legacy A is reconciled with shared care-source evidence, not claimed as a new universal current symbol.

title: DROPS Design, Fiesta yarn information and FAQ
passage_and_limitations: Different dye lots can differ in colour; even a printed yarn lot may vary. Does not justify always buying exactly one additional package.

title: Android Developers, String resources / Quantity strings
passage_and_limitations: Quantity selection is locale-sensitive and formatting arguments are separate. other is required; categories are grammatical, not a simple quantity=1 branch.

title: AOSP ResourcesImpl, getQuantityText
passage_and_limitations: Uses ICU plural rules for the configured locale and falls back to other. Source semantics are corroborated by existing actual Android tests; this moving branch is not the historical test APK identity.

title: Unicode CLDR 48, Language Plural Rules
passage_and_limitations: pt one: integer part0..1; pt_PT one: integer1 with no fractional digits. Modern rules include many for exact nonzero million multiples. Category rules do not mandate spelling digits as words or changing the app locale.

title: Ciberdúvidas, Zero, com ou sem plural?
passage_and_limitations: Explains the regional zero agreement difference; supports preserving actual configured Portuguese-locale selection rather than applying Spanish/English assumptions.

title: Ciberdúvidas, A escrita de numerais
passage_and_limitations: Digits are normal in measurements, tables and statistics. Compact numeric UI labels remain as written; no automatic insertion of de in every many form. This is not a claim about spelling out milhão.
